name: Elk Grove Village
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Elk Grove Village, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Elk Grove Village, IL: the Village Green tree lighting with fireworks and Santa, Winter Fun Fest, Grinch photos and a tween party.
lede: Elk Grove Village kicks off Christmas the day after Thanksgiving with a tree lighting on the Village Green, where more than 500,000 lights switch on, fireworks fill the sky and Santa poses for free photos. The park district adds a winter festival, a holiday bazaar with the Grinch and a party for tweens.
celebrates: Christmas in Elk Grove Village starts on the Village Green at 901 Wellington Avenue. At the Holiday Tree Lighting, families sip free cocoa and cider, kids ride the Elk Grove Express holiday train, and Village Board trustees read classic stories while the Rotary Club hands out children's books. The mayor then lights the tree and more than 500,000 lights, fireworks follow, and Santa takes free photos. The Elk Grove Park District fills December with a Holiday Bazaar that raises money for the Sheila Ray Adult Center, a new Winter Fun Fest at the Pavilion and a Tween Holiday Night. The Leo and Lions Clubs judge a Holiday House Decorating Contest.
lastyear: For 2025, the village planned its Holiday Tree Lighting for Friday, November 28, beginning at 4 pm. The plan included free cookies and cocoa, Storytime with the Board, rides on the Elk Grove Express, and a concert by The Box Tops, the band behind the hit The Letter. The tree lighting, fireworks and free photos with Santa were set for 5:30 pm. The park district also planned a Breakfast with Santa on December 6, 2025, at the Garden Terrace at the Pavilion.
facts: Elk Grove Village was incorporated on July 17, 1956, as a planned suburb, and Centex built most of its first houses. That makes 2026 the village's 70th year, and Village Hall is selling flat ceramic 70th anniversary holiday ornaments for $5 each while supplies last. The village takes its name from a small elk herd kept at the edge of Busse Woods, a tradition that began in the 1920s when William Busse brought elk from Montana by train. The village also has the largest consolidated business park in North America.
trains: Trains are part of the Elk Grove Village story, since its elk herd arrived from Montana by train in the 1920s. Today kids ride the Elk Grove Express on the Village Green at the tree lighting. The Elk Grove Park District also runs a Holiday Express Storytime Train that boards at the Itasca Metra station, at Irving Park Road and Maple Street on the Milwaukee District West line, and rides to Elgin and back with stories and Santa. The Illinois Railway Museum in Union and the Fox River Trolley Museum in South Elgin run Santa trains too.

kidfact: Elk Grove Village is named for real elk. In the 1920s a man named William Busse brought elk all the way from Montana by train, and a small herd still lives at the edge of Busse Woods.
faq: When is the Elk Grove Village tree lighting?

The Village of Elk Grove Village holds its Holiday Tree Lighting on the Friday after Thanksgiving on the Village Green at 901 Wellington Avenue. Activities begin at 4 pm with free refreshments, Storytime with the Board and the Elk Grove Express train ride, and the tree is lit at 5:30 pm, followed by fireworks and free photos with Santa.
Where can kids see Santa in Elk Grove Village?

Santa poses for free family photos on the Village Green right after the tree lighting fireworks. The village lists the photos as part of the evening, so there is nothing to book ahead. In past years the Elk Grove Park District has also hosted a Breakfast with Santa at the Garden Terrace at the Pavilion.
Where do we park for the Elk Grove Village tree lighting?

The village says the lots at the Elk Grove Public Library and the park district at 1000 Wellington are usually full by 4 pm. Other parking is at the park district office at 499 Biesterfield, Ascension Alexian Brothers Medical Center at 800 Biesterfield, the School District 59 office on Leicester and Byrd Elementary on Wellington.
Is there food at the Elk Grove Village tree lighting?

The village serves complimentary cookies, hot chocolate and hot cider while supplies last, and no food is sold at the event. Families who want a full meal should eat before or after. Smoking is not allowed, and leashed dogs are permitted, though the village warns the crowd and concert may upset pets.
Does Elk Grove Village have a holiday lights contest?

Yes. The Elk Grove Village Leo and Lions Clubs run a Holiday House Decorating Contest in December. Houses, apartments and condos are judged in four categories, including Best Creative Use of Decorations and Best Theme Display, and residents enter by email before the deadline the clubs set each year.
